faq_items.question: What is meant by the term 'Activate app'
faq_items.answer: To activate your app means to unlock and gain full access to all the app's contents.

faq_items.question: How can I activate
faq_items.answer: To activate your app you will need to pay a sum of ₦3000 using the payment methods provided.

faq_items.question: How do I make payment
faq_items.answer:
You can pay with 3 options.

1. Bank transfer/deposit: pay with any banking app or go to the bank to make payment. After payment you will need to send us an evidence of payment to our email scholarlyapp.ng@gmail.com


2. Cards: this is done online within the app with your atm card and your app gets activated instantly.


3. Online bank transfer: this is performed within the app with only your account number and does not require the use of atm card

faq_items.question: How long does the activation lasts
faq_items.answer: Your activation will last for one academic year. No recurrent subscription fee or hidden charges.

faq_items.question: I cannot afford activation fee. What do I do
faq_items.answer: There is a limited opportunity for people to activate with just ₦1500 when they refer 5 friends to the app. Visit Profile > Invite Friends Promo for this offer.

faq_items.question: Can activation be used in multiple devices
faq_items.answer: No, only one device per activation

faq_items.question: What is a Product Key
faq_items.answer: A product key is a unique 16 digits alphanumeric key that is used to identify a device

faqs.faq_title: How to use Scholarly UTME App

faq_items.question: How to check your performance
faq_items.answer: Go to 'Account' screen and click on 'My Performance'

faq_items.question: How to check your bookmarked questions
faq_items.answer: Go to 'Account' screen and click on 'My Saved Questions'

faq_items.question: How update your profile
faq_items.answer: Go to 'Account' screen and click on the card displaying your email and product key. Click 'Save' button after making changes to your profile

faq_items.question: How to share questions
faq_items.answer: Click on the share icon at the top left or bottom right corner. A dialog will appear, then select the platform you would like to share the question on. Make sure you accept all necessary permissions.

faq_items.question: How to share your results
faq_items.answer: Click on the 'Share screenshot' button at the Result screen. A dialog will appear, then select the platform you would like to share the question on. Make sure you accept all necessary permissions.

faq_items.question: How to report wrong questions, answers and explanation
faq_items.answer: Click on the report icon, the second item (first item for cbt game) at the top left corner or the third item at the bottom left corner. A bottomsheet dialog will appear. Tick and fill in the necessary fields and click the 'Submit' button

faq_items.question: How to refer a friend
faq_items.answer: Go to 'Account' screen and click on 'Invite Friends Promo' Click on the 'Share my referral link now' button to share your link via any social media patform or 'Copy link' button to copy your link.

faq_items.question: How to turn off sounds and vibrations
faq_items.answer: Go to 'Settings' screen, under the 'Preference category', toggle off the 'Enable in app sound' and 'Enable vibrations' switches. Also within the Exam Screens, sound and vibrations can be turned off from the dropdown menu at the topmost right corner of the screens.

faq_items.question: How to turn off notifications
faq_items.answer: Go to 'Settings' screen, under the 'Preference category', toggle off the 'Enable message notifications' switch

faq_items.question: How to change cbt game mode
faq_items.answer: At the 'CBT Game' screen, click at the 3 vertical dots check and uncheck the 'Show solution' menu item to determine the cbt game mode you prefer.
